g.text: Unfamiliar meanings · fixed 600 epochs · frozen CLIP · 1027 inputs, no products
Lines: mean of three seeds. Shading: seed range, not confidence intervals.
Test curves are post-hoc every 10 epochs; no test-driven selection. L2 penalty is excluded from these data-loss curves.
